public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.quantitative_future_probe_tv_budget
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {A : Type uA} {O : Type uO} {I : Type uI} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype I]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq O]
  (K : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.FiniteControlledStochasticKernel X A) (read : X → O)
  (probe : I → List (A × O))
  (coeff :
    ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read)) →
      I → ℝ),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FutureTestsResolvePredictiveClasses K read probe coeff →
    ∀ (x y : X) (a : A),
      read x = read y →
        ∀ (eps : I → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : I),
              |UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read x ((a, read x) :: probe i) -
                    UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read y
                      ((a, read x) :: probe i)| ≤
                eps i) →
            UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
                (PMF.map
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read))
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF K x a)).toMeasure
                (PMF.map
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read))
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF K y a)).toMeasure ≤
              min 1 (1 / 2 * ∑ c, ∑ i, |coeff c i| * eps i)

  [inst_2 : DecidableEq O]
  (K : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.FiniteControlledStochasticKernel X A) (read : X → O)
  (probe : I → List (A × O))
  (coeff :
    ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read)) →
      I → ℝ),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FutureTestsResolvePredictiveClasses K read probe coeff →
    ∀ (x y : X) (a : A),
      read x = read y →
        ∀ (xMeasured yMeasured alpha beta : I → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : I),
              |UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read x ((a, read x) :: probe i) -
                    xMeasured i| ≤
                alpha i) →
            (∀ (i : I),
                |UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read y
                        ((a, read x) :: probe i) -
                      yMeasured i| ≤
                  beta i) →

                  (PMF.map
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read))
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF K x a)).toMeasure
                  (PMF.map
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.stochasticFuture K read))
                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF K y a)).toMeasure ≤
                min 1 (1 / 2 * ∑ c, ∑ i, |coeff c i| * (alpha i + |xMeasured i - yMeasured i| + beta i))

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.approximate_observable_partition_tv_budget
public_source_theorems.type:

  [inst_2 : Fintype I] (M : UEOT.V3.FiniteStablePartition.Model X A R O) (S : Setoid X) (test : I → X → ℝ)
  (coeff : X → I → ℝ) (delta eps kappa : ℝ),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.ApproxSpansPartitionIndicators S test coeff delta →
    UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.ApproxSameTestExpectationsOnFibers M S test eps →
      0 ≤ eps →
        (∀ (z : X), ∑ i, |coeff z i| ≤ kappa) →
          ∀ {x y : X},
            S x y →
              ∀ (a : A),
                UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
                    (PMF.map
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation S))
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel M) x
                          a)).toMeasure
                    (PMF.map
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation S))
                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel M) y
                          a)).toMeasure ≤
                  min 1
                    (1 / 2 *
                      (↑(Fintype.card
                            ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
                                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation S))) *
                        (2 * delta + eps * kappa)))

public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {A : Type uA} {R : Type uR} {O : Type uO} {I : Type uI} [inst : Fintype X] [Fintype A]
  [inst_2 : Fintype I] (M : UEOT.V3.FiniteStablePartition.Model X A R O) (S : Setoid X) (test : I → X → ℝ)
  (coeff : X → I → ℝ) (measured : A → X → I → ℝ) (delta eta rho kappa : ℝ),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.ApproxSpansPartitionIndicators S test coeff delta →
    (∀ (a : A) (x : X) (i : I),
        |UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.transitionTestExpectation M (test i) a x -
              measured a x i| ≤
          rho) →
      (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, S x y → ∀ (a : A) (i : I), |measured a x i - measured a y i| ≤ eta) →
        0 ≤ eta →
          0 ≤ rho →
            (∀ (z : X), ∑ i, |coeff z i| ≤ kappa) →
              ∀ {x y : X},
                S x y →
                  ∀ (a : A),
                    UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
                        (PMF.map
                            (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation S))
                            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel M) x
                              a)).toMeasure
                        (PMF.map
                            (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation S))
                            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel M) y
                              a)).toMeasure ≤
                      min 1
                        (1 / 2 *
                          (↑(Fintype.card
                                ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
                                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                      S))) *
                            (2 * delta + (eta + 2 * rho) * kappa)))

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finite_horizon_path_error
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {H₀ Z : Type u} [Fintype H₀] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace H₀] [MeasurableSingletonClass H₀]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] (p₀ : PMF H₀)
  (K L : (n : ℕ) → UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory H₀ Z n → PMF Z) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ),
  (∀ n < T, 0 ≤ ε n) →
    (∀ n < T, ε n ≤ 1) →
      (∀ n < T,
          ∀ (h : UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory H₀ Z n),
            UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K n h).toMeasure (L n h).toMeasure ≤ ε n) →
        UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀ K T).toMeasure
              (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀ L T).toMeasure ≤
            1 - ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T, (1 - ε i) ∧
          1 - ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T, (1 - ε i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range T, ε i

      (T : ℕ),

          UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.ApproxSpansPartitionIndicators S (test n)
            (coeff n) (delta n)) →

              |UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.transitionTestExpectation (M n) (test n i) a
                      x -

                rho n) →
          (∀ n < T, ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, S x y → ∀ (a : A) (i : I), |measured n a x i - measured n a y i| ≤ eta n) →
            (∀ n < T, 0 ≤ delta n) →

                (∀ n < T, 0 ≤ rho n) →

                                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskHistoryMap

                                          S)
                                        ax.2))
                                  T)
                                (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀
                                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel
                                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                        S))
                                    (fun n x a =>
                                      UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                                        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel
                                          (M n))
                                        x a)
                                    π)
                                  T)).toMeasure
                            (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw
                                (PMF.map
                                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                      S))
                                  p₀)
                                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMacroControlKernel
                                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskRepresentativeKernel
                                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.toReachable
                                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                        S))
                                    r fun n x a =>
                                    UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.finiteKernelRowPMF
                                      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.modelAsFiniteKernel
                                        (M n))
                                      x a)
                                  π)
                                T).toMeasure ≤
                          1 -
                            ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T,
                              (1 -
                                (fun n =>
                                    min 1
                                      (1 / 2 *
                                        (↑(Fintype.card
                                              ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
                                                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                                    S))) *
                                          (2 * delta n + (eta n + 2 * rho n) * kappa n))))
                                  i) ∧
                        1 -
                            ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T,
                              (1 -
                                (fun n =>
                                    min 1
                                      (1 / 2 *
                                        (↑(Fintype.card
                                              ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
                                                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                                    S))) *
                                          (2 * delta n + (eta n + 2 * rho n) * kappa n))))
                                  i) ≤
                          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range T,
                            (fun n =>
                                min 1
                                  (1 / 2 *
                                    (↑(Fintype.card
                                          ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.RecursiveSufficientState.ReachableState
                                              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.ScientificClosure.SISC.setoidRepresentation
                                                S))) *
                                      (2 * delta n + (eta n + 2 * rho n) * kappa n))))
                              i

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_map_extend_apply
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [inst : Fintype X] [Fintype Z] (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (K : X → PMF Z)
  (y : Y) (z : Z),
  (PMF.map (fun hz => (f hz.1, hz.2)) (UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend p K)) (y, z) =
    ∑ x, if f x = y then p x * (K x) z else 0

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_map_extend_eq
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Z] (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (K : X → PMF Z)
  (fallback : Y → PMF Z),
  PMF.map (fun hz => (f hz.1, hz.2)) (UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend p K) =
    UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend (PMF.map f p)
      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskConditionedRow p f K fallback)

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_map_extend_right
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} (p : PMF X) (K : X → PMF Y) (g : Y → Z),
  PMF.map (fun hz => (hz.1, g hz.2)) (UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend p K) =
    UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend p fun x => PMF.map g (K x)

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_commonMass_bind_lower_bound
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [inst : Fintype Z] (p : PMF X) (K L : X → PMF Z) (s : ℝ),
  (∀ x ∈ p.support, s ≤ UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfCommonMass (K x) (L x)) →
    s ≤ UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfCommonMass (p.bind K) (p.bind L)

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_tv_bind_same_weights
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
  (p : PMF X) (K L : X → PMF Z) (ε : ℝ),
  (∀ x ∈ p.support, UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K x).toMeasure (L x).toMeasure ≤ ε) →
    UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (p.bind K).toMeasure (p.bind L).toMeasure ≤ ε

public_source_theorems.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_conditionedRow_tv_le
public_source_theorems.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (K : X → PMF Z) (L : Y → PMF Z) (ε : ℝ),
  0 ≤ ε →
    (∀ (x : X), UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K x).toMeasure (L (f x)).toMeasure ≤ ε) →
      ∀ (y : Y),
        UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskConditionedRow p f K L y).toMeasure
            (L y).toMeasure ≤
          ε
